cards.title: ratings-lib: RATING_SCALE, notchChange and notchCalculator (REQ-06-02)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-06-02 needs a notch calculator that later Watchlist POC screens will import. This card also provides the shared notchChange that Indicator 12 (T-02) is built on. WL = Watchlist level (0-4, higher is worse).

CONVENTIONS (CLAUDE.md): plain Node.js 18+ ES modules (.mjs). No npm dependencies, do not add any. Pure functions, no I/O in src/ratings: no node:fs, node:http, node:net, fetch(, console., or process.std. Tests use node:test with node:assert/strict. No Node 20+ only APIs (toSorted, toReversed, Object.groupBy, t.assert). src/ and test/ hold only .gitkeep. Named exports only (no default). JSDoc on each export. No docs or changelog.

FILES: create src/ratings/notch.mjs and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs. Work TDD: tests first.

CONTRACT (frozen):
1) export const RATING_SCALE: an Array, best first, Object.freeze'd: ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"] (19 entries). ESM is strict mode so RATING_SCALE.push("D") throws TypeError and the length stays 19.
2) export function notchChange(previous, current) -> integer index(current) - index(previous). Downgrade positive, upgrade negative, same rating +0 (Object.is(result, 0) true, never -0).
3) export function notchCalculator(previous, current) -> { notches, direction, wl } with exactly these three keys. notches === notchChange(previous, current) (signed; human decision CON-interface: BB -> BBB is -3). direction: "downgrade" if notches > 0, "upgrade" if < 0, "unchanged" if 0. wl uses Indicator 13 thresholds: 2 if notches >= 3, 1 if notches === 2, else 0 (a 1-notch downgrade gives WL 0, C6; upgrades and unchanged give 0, C3).
Note: the POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notch, WL=1' is wrong; correct is 3 notches, WL 2 (C2).

INPUT HANDLING (C1, CON-errors, X-input-trim, X-input-nonstring), both arguments of both functions: a non-string (null, undefined, missing, number, object, array) throws RangeError. Otherwise String.prototype.trim() then toUpperCase(), looked up in RATING_SCALE (trim also strips U+00A0). Internal whitespace is not removed: "BBB +" and "B B" throw. Anything not on the scale throws RangeError ("", "   ", "D", "SD", "NR", "CC", "AAA+", "CCC--", "Baa1"): no mapping, no default. The message names the bad input; tests check the error type only. T-02 must use notchChange and must not repeat the scale. Do not create a shared WL-threshold helper: T-02 uses different thresholds.

OUT OF SCOPE: Indicator 13 as its own export, fetching ratings, override/persistence/audit, logging or printed output.
acceptance: 1. [unit] AC-1: Given `import { RATING_SCALE } from "../../src/ratings/notch.mjs"`, when it is inspected, then: ; `assert.deepEqual(RATING_SCALE, ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"])` ; `RATING_SCALE.length === 19` ; `Array.isArray(RATING_SCALE) === true` ; `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`

2. [unit] AC-1: Given the frozen scale, when `RATING_SCALE.push("D")` runs, then it throws `TypeError`, `RATING_SCALE.length === 19` and `RATING_SCALE[18] === "CCC-"`. When `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` runs, then it throws `TypeError` and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"`.

3. [unit] AC-2: Given valid ratings, when `notchChange` is called on a downgrade, then the result is positive: `("BBB+","BB+")` = 3, `("BBB+","BBB-")` = 2, `("BBB","BBB-")` = 1, `("A","BBB+")` = 2, `("AAA","CCC-")` = 18.
4. [unit] AC-3: Given valid ratings, when `notchChange` is called on an upgrade, then the result is negative: `("BB","BBB")` = -3, `("BBB-","BBB")` = -1, `("A-","A")` = -1, `("CCC-","AAA")` = -18.
5. [unit] AC-4: Given the same rating twice, when `notchChange` is called, then `Object.is(result, 0) === true` for `("BBB","BBB")`, `("AAA","AAA")` and `("CCC-","CCC-")`.

6. [unit] AC-5: Given input that differs only in case or in leading/trailing whitespace, when `notchChange` is called, then: ; `(" bbb+ ","BB+")` = 3 ; `("\tBbB+\n","bb+")` = 3 ; `("aa-","AA-")` = 0, with `Object.is(…, 0)` ; `(" ccc- ","AAA")` = -18 ; `(" BBB ","BBB-")` = 1

7. [unit] AC-5: Given lower-case or padded input, when `notchCalculator` is called, then: ; `("bbb+","bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` ; `(" bbb "," BBB- ")` deep-equals `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`

8. [unit] AC-6: Given each invalid value V from the Test data "Invalid inputs" table, when `notchChange(V, "BBB")` and `notchChange("BBB", V)` are called, then each throws `RangeError` (`assert.throws(fn, RangeError)`). No value is returned.
9. [unit] AC-6: Given the same invalid values V, when `notchCalculator(V, "BBB")` and `notchCalculator("BBB", V)` are called, then each throws `RangeError`. No object and no default WL is returned.

10. [unit] AC-6: Given missing or doubly invalid arguments, when the following are called, then each throws `RangeError`: `notchChange("BBB")`, `notchChange()`, `notchCalculator("BBB")`, `notchCalculator()`, `notchChange("D","NR")`, `notchCalculator("", null)`.

11. [unit] AC-7: Given a downgrade of 3 or more notches, when `notchCalculator` is called, then: ; `("BBB+","BB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` ; `("AAA","CCC-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 18, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }` ; boundary: `("AAA","AA-")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`
12. [unit] AC-8: Given a downgrade of exactly 2 notches, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `("BBB+","BBB-")` and `("A","BBB+")` each deep-equal `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }`.
13. [unit] AC-9: Given a downgrade of exactly 1 notch, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `("BBB","BBB-")` and `("CCC","CCC-")` each deep-equal `{ notches: 1, direction: "downgrade", wl: 0 }`.

14. [unit] AC-10: Given an upgrade, when `notchCalculator` is called, then: ; `("BB","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` ; `("BBB-","BBB")` deep-equals `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` ; `("A-","A")` deep-equals `{ notches: -1, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` ; `("CCC-","AAA")` deep-equals `{ notches: -18, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` ; mirror boundaries, which catch a `Math.abs` bug: `("BBB-","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: -2, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }` and `("BB+","BBB+")` deep-equals `{ notches: -3, direction: "upgrade", wl: 0 }`

15. [unit] AC-11: Given the same rating twice, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `("BBB","BBB")`, `("AAA","AAA")` and `("CCC-","CCC-")` each deep-equal `{ notches: 0, direction: "unchanged", wl: 0 }`, with `Object.is(result.notches, 0)`.
16. [unit] AC-12: Given any valid pair, e.g. `("BBB+","BB+")`, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `Object.keys(result).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]`.

17. [QA] AC-12: Given all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` from `RATING_SCALE`, when `notchCalculator(p, c)` is called, then for every pair: ; `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]` ; `r.notches === notchChange(p, c)` and `r.notches === RATING_SCALE.indexOf(c) - RATING_SCALE.indexOf(p)` ; `r.direction` is `"downgrade"` if notches > 0, `"upgrade"` if < 0, `"unchanged"` if 0 ; `r.wl === (r.notches >= 3 ? 2 : r.notches === 2 ? 1 : 0)`
18. [QA] AC-12: Given the same 361 results, when they are counted, then: ; direction: downgrade 171, upgrade 171, unchanged 19 ; wl: wl 2 = 136, wl 1 = 17, wl 0 = 208
19. [QA] AC-5: Given all 361 pairs, when `notchCalculator(p.toLowerCase(), " " + c.toLowerCase() + "\t")` is called, then it deep-equals `notchCalculator(p, c)`.
20. [QA] AC-18: Given the delivered source, when `grep -nE "node:fs|node:http|node:net|fetch\(|console\.|process\.std" src/ratings/notch.mjs` runs, then there are no matches (grep exits 1).

21. [QA] AC-18: Given a child process (`spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--input-type=module","-e", "import {notchChange, notchCalculator} from './src/ratings/notch.mjs'; notchChange('BBB','BBB-'); notchCalculator('BBB+','BB+');"])` run from the repo root), when it exits, then the status is 0 and `stdout === ""` and `stderr === ""`.

22. [QA] AC-19: Given `import * as m from "./src/ratings/notch.mjs"`, then: ; `typeof m.notchChange === "function"` ; `typeof m.notchCalculator === "function"` ; `Array.isArray(m.RATING_SCALE)` ; `"default" in m === false` ; the source file has the `.mjs` extension

23. [QA] AC-19: Given the card branch, then: ; `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` exits 0 with `# fail 0` ; `git diff --exit-code main -- package.json` exits 0 ; no `package-lock.json` or `node_modules/` exists ; `grep -nE "toSorted|toReversed|Object\.groupBy|t\.assert" src/ratings/notch.mjs test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` has no matches (Node 18 compatibility)

cards.title: indicators-lib: Indicator 12 countryRatingChangeWl (REQ-03-12)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-03-12, Indicator 12 (country rating change): previous and current country rating -> WL 0, 1 or 2. The notch count must come from the shared notchChange in ratings-lib (T-01, merged first). WL = Watchlist level (0-4, higher is worse).

CONVENTIONS (CLAUDE.md): plain Node.js 18+ ESM (.mjs). No npm dependencies. Pure function, no I/O in src/indicators: no node:fs, node:http, node:net, fetch(, console., or process.std. Tests use node:test with node:assert/strict. No Node 20+ only APIs. Named exports only. JSDoc on the export. No docs or changelog.

FILES: create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. TDD: tests first. Do not edit src/ratings/** (T-01).

UPSTREAM CONTRACT (src/ratings/notch.mjs): notchChange(previous, current) = index(current) - index(previous) on the 19-rating C1 scale (AAA best ... CCC- worst); downgrade positive, upgrade negative, equal 0. It trims, case-folds, and throws RangeError on any invalid or non-string input in either position. RATING_SCALE is exported there too.

CONTRACT (frozen): export function countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> 0 | 1 | 2. Import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"; n = notchChange(previous, current); return 2 if n >= 2, 1 if n === 1, else 0 (upgrades and unchanged -> 0, C3). These thresholds differ from notchCalculator (1 at 2 notches, 2 at 3+): do not reuse notchCalculator().wl or a shared threshold helper; BBB -> BBB- gives 1 here and 0 in notchCalculator. No rating string literals and no scale of its own in the file. Validation is delegated: let RangeError propagate, do not catch it, no default WL. Arity exactly 2 (countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2): no default/rest params, no override flag, no module state. Editable value (C7): the caller passes the edited rating. Persistence, audit, public-source fetch (C4) out of scope.

JOB-LEVEL CHECK: after this card, node --test from the integration worktree must exit 0 and pick up both unit test files; package.json must have no dependencies.
acceptance: 1. [unit] AC-13: Given a 1-notch downgrade, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then `("BBB","BBB-")`, `("AAA","AA+")` and `("CCC","CCC-")` each `=== 1`.
2. [unit] AC-13 (C6): Given the pair `("BBB","BBB-")`, when both indicators are called, then `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BBB-") === 1` and `notchCalculator("BBB","BBB-").wl === 0`.

3. [unit] AC-14: Given a downgrade of 2 or more notches, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then each of these `=== 2`: ; `("BBB+","BBB-")` (2 notches) ; `("A","BBB+")` (2 notches) ; `("BBB+","BB+")` (3 notches) ; `("AAA","CCC-")` (18 notches)

4. [unit] AC-15: Given an upgrade or an unchanged rating, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then each of these `=== 0` (the number 0, not `false`/`null`/`-0`): ; `("BBB-","BBB")`, `("BB","BBB")`, `("CCC-","AAA")`, `("A","A")` ; `("A-","A")`, `("BBB-","BBB+")`, `("AAA","AAA")`, `("CCC-","CCC-")`

5. [unit] AC-5: Given input that differs only in case or in leading/trailing whitespace, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then: ; `(" bbb ","bbb-")` === 1 ; `(" A-\t","bb+")` === 2 ; `("aaa","AAA")` === 0

6. [unit] AC-6: Given each invalid value V from the T-01 "Invalid inputs" list, when `countryRatingChangeWl(V, "BBB")` and `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB", V)` are called, then each throws `RangeError`. No 0/1/2 is returned.

7. [unit] AC-6: Given missing or doubly invalid arguments, when `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB")`, `countryRatingChangeWl()` and `countryRatingChangeWl("D","NR")` are called, then each throws `RangeError`.
8. [unit] AC-17: Given an analyst-edited rating passed by the caller, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then `("A-","BB+")` === 2 (4 notches) and `("A-","BBB")` === 2 (2 notches).

9. [unit] AC-17: Given the export, then: ; `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2` ; a third argument is ignored: `("BBB","BBB-", true)` === 1 and `("BBB","BBB-", { wl: 0 })` === 1 ; calling `("A-","BB+")`, then `("BBB","BBB")`, then `("A-","BB+")` returns 2, 0, 2 (no state)

10. [QA] AC-16: Given `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`: ; `grep -nE "import\s*\{[^}]*\bnotchChange\b[^}]*\}\s*from\s*[\"']\.\./ratings/notch\.mjs[\"']"` has at least one match. ; `grep -n "notchCalculator"` has no matches. ; `grep -nE "AAA|AA[+-]|BBB|BB[+-]|CCC|\bA[+-]|\bB[+-]"` has no matches. This covers the whole file, comments included. ; `grep -nE "\btry\b|\bcatch\b"` has no matches.

11. [QA] AC-16: Given all 361 ordered pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE`, when `countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)` is called, then for every pair: ; the result is an integer in {0, 1, 2} ; it equals `n >= 2 ? 2 : n === 1 ? 1 : 0`, where `n = notchChange(p, c)`
12. [QA] AC-16: Given the 361 results, when they are counted, then WL 2 = 153 pairs, WL 1 = 18 pairs, WL 0 = 190 pairs.

13. [QA] AC-16 (C6): Given the 361 pairs, when `countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)` is compared with `notchCalculator(p, c).wl`, then they differ on exactly 35 pairs: ; the 18 one-notch downgrades (1 vs 0) ; the 17 two-notch downgrades (2 vs 1) ; they are equal on the other 326
14. [QA] AC-5: Given all 361 pairs, when `countryRatingChangeWl(" " + p.toLowerCase(), c.toLowerCase() + " ")` is called, then it equals `countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)`.
15. [QA] AC-18: Given the source, when `grep -nE "node:fs|node:http|node:net|fetch\(|console\.|process\.std" src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` runs, then there are no matches.

16. [QA] AC-18: Given a child process (`spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--input-type=module","-e","import {countryRatingChangeWl} from './src/indicators/countryRating.mjs'; countryRatingChangeWl('BBB','BBB-');"])` from the repo root), when it exits, then the status is 0 and `stdout === ""` and `stderr === ""`.
17. [QA] AC-19: Given `import * as m from "./src/indicators/countryRating.mjs"`, then `typeof m.countryRatingChangeWl === "function"` and `"default" in m === false`.

18. [QA] AC-19 (job-level), in the integration worktree after T-01 and T-02 are merged: ; `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` exits 0 with `# fail 0`. ; `node --test test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` exits 0 with `# fail 0`. ; Bare `node --test` exits 0 with `# fail 0`, and its `# tests` count is at least the sum of the two counts above.

19. [QA] AC-19 (job-level), in the same integration worktree: ; `git diff --exit-code main -- package.json` exits 0, so there are still no `dependencies`/`devDependencies`. ; No `package-lock.json` or `node_modules/` exists. ; `grep -nE "toSorted|toReversed|Object\.groupBy|t\.assert" src/indicators/countryRating.mjs test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` has no matches.
